title: Mileage Credit on a Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease for Kestrel Care Plan Holders
content:
**Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease — mileage credit for holders of a Kestrel Care plan**

**Clause.** The Kestrel Care mileage credit is 1000 miles (the financed-plan miles) when the customer holds an active Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract financed in a Kestrel contract or lease; 500 miles (the cash-plan miles) when the customer's active Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract was paid in cash; and nothing when the customer holds no active Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract. Where the customer's Care records list more than one active plan, the first active plan listed is the one read. The credited miles are added to the mileage allowance before the miles driven are compared with it.

| Active Kestrel Care plan (first listed) | How the plan price was paid | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| held | financed in a Kestrel new-vehicle retail, pre-owned retail, balloon contract or lease | 1000 miles |
| held | cash | 500 miles |
| no active plan | — | nothing |

**Hypothetical illustration**: a lessee whose Kestrel Care Platinum plan was financed in a Kestrel Advantage Balloon contract turns in a lease with miles driven of 37400 against an allowance of 36000; the allowance is compared as 37000, leaving 400 miles over.
